partnership_announcements.description: Tanmiah Food Company and geothermal cooling firm Strataphy announced a partnership to deploy a pilot geothermal‑cooled poultry facility at Tanmiah’s Shaqrah site in Saudi Arabia under Strataphy’s Cooling‑as‑a‑Service model.

press_references.value: Tanmiah partners with McDonald’s Saudi Arabia

partnership_announcements.description: Tanmiah Food Company and McDonald’s Saudi Arabia have announced a strategic partnership to promote the supply of locally sourced poultry to McDonald’s restaurants, supporting food security, local agriculture, and sustainability in Saudi Arabia.

press_references.value: Tanmiah Food Company and Emerge partner to advance energy transformation

partnership_announcements.description: Tanmiah Food Company and Emerge have announced a partnership to develop a 3 MWp solar power plant at Tanmiah's facility in Haradh, Saudi Arabia. This collaboration aims to advance energy transformation and sustainability in the agricultural sector, supporting Saudi Arabia's net-zero goals. Emerge will provide a full turnkey solution, including finance, design, procurement, construction, operations, and maintenance for 25 years.

press_references.value: Tanmiah Continues Its Sustainability Journey with the Introduction of 100% Electric, Zero-Emission Trucks

product_launches.description: Tanmiah Food Company has launched 100% electric, zero-emission refrigerated trucks for its logistics and distribution operations, marking the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's first fully refrigerated electric truck for local fresh chicken transportation. product.name: Fresh Poultry
product.description: Fresh halal chicken sold as whole birds and portions, including breasts, wings and other cuts for household, retail and foodservice preparation.

product.name: Frozen Poultry
product.description: Frozen chicken products, including whole birds and portions, supplied for retail, household cooking and foodservice applications.

product.name: Added-Value Poultry Products
product.description: Ready-to-cook and ready-to-eat poultry products such as breaded chicken, burgers, nuggets, wings, strips, cooked breasts and toppings.

product.name: Marinated Chicken Range
product.description: Pre-cleaned and marinated chicken products prepared with flavors such as tandoori, spicy, shish tawouk, curry, coriander and lime, or pesto.
